notes: Defined 4 non-duplicate stories aligned to schema, core logic, API, and tests for Brain lock TTL and recovery.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for lock TTL and ownership
Added core logic for TTL enforcement and deadlock recovery
Added internal API for lock lifecycle operations
Added unit and integration test suite for lock behavior

BL-0.1.4-003-S1.title: Brain Lock Schema with TTL and Ownership Contract
BL-0.1.4-003-S1.description: Define lock data model including lock_id, owner_id (runner/agent), acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status fields. Establish contract for single-owner enforcement and expiration semantics.

BL-0.1.4-003-S2.title: TTL Enforcement and Deadlock Recovery Logic
BL-0.1.4-003-S2.description: Implement logic to enforce lock expiration, detect stale locks, and safely reclaim them. Include deadlock recovery by allowing new owner acquisition after TTL expiry with validation against active execution.

BL-0.1.4-003-S3.title: Internal Lock Management API (Acquire, Renew, Release)
BL-0.1.4-003-S3.description: Expose internal functions for acquiring, renewing (heartbeat), and releasing locks with TTL updates. Ensure ownership validation and rejection of invalid or concurrent acquisition attempts.

BL-0.1.4-003-S4.title: Lock TTL and Deadlock Recovery Test Suite
BL-0.1.4-003-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiry, concurrent access, stale lock recovery, and deadlock scenarios to validate correctness under race conditions.

BL-0.1.4-003.mitigation: Enforce strict TTL expiry and ownership validation before lock reuse
